scope: Space continuation: explicit existing-Context attach, selected locator recovery, diagnostics, visible Context enumeration and workspace-directory registration
behaviors_verified: Attach reads an existing Context and original committed creation proof, preserves identity, does not allocate an ID or rewrite its SQLite body
Lost locator recovery operates only on an explicitly selected directory; does not scan sibling directories or recreate missing Contexts
A new public data root can register an existing body; source creation provenance remains unchanged
Pending creation registration is repaired only after a matching committed body is observed
Duplicate physical copies of one Context identity cause conflict; no silent merge or locator rebind
Unknown attach apply remains unknown on replay, while a confirmed commit with a lost reply is recovered
Location diagnostics preserve registered identity/location and distinguish missing or invalid source without creating a database
Context enumeration individually authorizes and rechecks every projection, reports authorized source failures, hides inaccessible records and completeness side channels
Workspace directory registration, change and clear are revisioned metadata operations; offline paths are retained and no directory/file move occurs
Legacy literal v1 registry without directory fields is read without automatic migration or revision changes
Receipt-revision inconsistency and exhausted business revisions fail closed before new invalid data is committed

compatibility.extension: Space.directory is optional; existing records remain valid without it. New readers accept legacy records unchanged; this is not a downgrade compatibility claim for the old strict reader after a directory field is written.

evidence_layers.real: shared SQLite, filesystem roots/leases, actual close/reopen, source file hashes, two public data roots
evidence_layers.injected: trusted host allow decisions, object projection bindings and storage failures
evidence_layers.permissions: real local-entry refusal verified, no conversation impersonation

not_completed: Placement/multiple Space placements remain a product-model decision
Fresh data-root initialization still requires a trusted host initializer
Context settings beyond initial name/description remain unimplemented
Destructive deletion, physical migration, automatic merging and backup-based restoration of lost organization data are not implemented
General uncertain ordinary mutations remain observation-only rather than automatically replayed
Production local-entry allow policy, App/IPC positive integration, actual API/AI owner ports and Windows desktop acceptance are still blocked or unverified
